 Realme topped the ranking of smartphones with the best battery life in 2026 
 UA NEWS
 19
 November
 2026
 15:00
-->
 Experts at GSMArena have updated their ranking of smartphones based on battery life. The Realme P4 Power, with a 10,001 mAh battery, took first place. 
 Based on the Active Use Score, the smartphone delivered 25 hours and 35 minutes of active use.  
   In talk time mode, it can last up to 61 hours. The device also supports 80-watt fast charging. 
 The top five also included the Oppo Find X10 Pro Max, Poco X8 Pro Max, and Oppo Find X10. All of these models provide over 25 hours of active use. 
 Meanwhile, the iPhone 18 Pro Max ranked only 30th with a result of 19 hours and 20 minutes—nearly six hours less than the leader of the ranking. 
 Source: GSMArena. 
 Global smartphone shipments in the third quarter of 2026 fell by 20% year-over-year to 254.7 million devices.  
 Well-known tech blogger Zach Nelson, creator of the YouTube channel JerryRigEverything, took apart the Trump T1 smartphone, which is marketed as an American product. Inside the device, he discovered a design virtually identical to that of the Taiwanese HTC U24 Pro, which is manufactured in China. An experiment swapping the motherboards confirmed that both smartphones can function with each other’s components. 
 In Nigeria, Infinix unveiled the GT 50 Pro gaming smartphone, featuring the HydroFlow liquid cooling system, mechanical triggers, and the MediaTek Dimensity 8400 Ultimate chip.
